title.description: The title of the page that lists the site's pages.

description.defaultMessage: The pages written here: what each says, and what search engines show for it.
description.description: The line under the title of the page that lists the pages written in the admin: what the list is. The home page and About Us are not among them: they are in the settings.

new.description: The button that opens the form of a new page of the site, and the title of that form's dialog.

newDescription.defaultMessage: Its metadata comes first. What is written on it is added on its own page, once it is saved.
newDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that adds a new page: what the form asks for, and where the rest is written.

notFound.description: The error shown when an address names a page of the site that does not exist.

page.description: The tab of a page's own page in the admin that holds its metadata and what is written on it.
